If it is okay, I would like to request an illustration of Momiji Inubashiri as a Deino:
https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/111585668
Momiji is a character from Touhou who, with the collar equipped onto her, became a Deino with her form being locked as a Deino until the collar is removed by the character who put it on her. 
Personality-wise, she can be said to be usually serious and cooperative, but not submissive. As a Deino, Momiji additionally tends to act shyer than usual because of the circumstances of being turned into a Deino.

Here are a few more references of Deino Momiji:
https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/99614801
https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/106618779
https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/113482442

I wouldn't have any other specifications for this so feel welcome to draw her however you want.

Thank you.

hello i really love your art i would like to commission a pmd drawing of my 5 ocs here is all info below

The background info: this is all taking place in a forest during the autumn season as we can see the falling leaves, our main characters are on a dirt path that's leading to a cave on the right. During this time it also has struck sunset so most of the sky is an orange tint, in this massive forest there also many hills and bushes too

Kelly is in the front of the team, she's holding a treasure map and pointing out towards the cave, she looks towards her team while pointing out that they should go in

Glacier the greninja checks  his sachet, that's around his waist to make sure that he has the items they need for the dungeon so they can go in prepared

Luke Is walking next to them while eating a yacha berry, and is holding a shuca berry in his other hand,
His bag on his tail is over filled with lots of other berries and is starting to spill out but he doesn't notice as he's trying to get a good look at the map

Tyler is holding Andre while walking with everyone and is looking slightly up at the autumn forest trees,he has his blue scarf on and is wearing a satchel around his waist, the satchel itself is pretty large so it fits fo the goodra to wear

Andre is trying to look at Kelly's map while being held by the goodra and is taking a big interest in the the treasure that's drawn on the map
